title: Headless Chrome keychain prompts: fixed launch, CI-only pre-push
description: The glyph triage gate launched Chrome for Testing with --headless and --dump-dom but no keychain suppression, so each pre-push raised five macOS keychain prompts. The launch now passes --use-mock-keychain, a lint watches tests/ and bin/ for regressions, and HQ_CI_ONLY=1 skips the unit tier in the pre-push hook.
